skill_drafts.name: API Instrumentation Development Pattern

skill_drafts.objective: Instrument external API integrations consistently with observability and tracing support
applicable_signals: Adding observability to a new third-party API provider
Need to capture method calls, parameters, and responses
Both sync and async execution paths present
contraindications: Internal utility functions without external API calls
One-off debugging or ad-hoc tracing tasks
intervention_moves: Leverage common module utilities for consistency
Wrap API operations in try-except blocks
Add inline documentation for captured attributes
Create unit tests for instrumentation logic

skill_drafts.name: Semantic Attribute Capture for API Calls
skill_drafts.description: Extract and log standardized attributes from API requests and responses using semantic conventions. Ensures consistent metadata (model name, token counts, latency, error codes) across all instrumented API calls.
skill_drafts.objective: Ensure consistent semantic metadata across all instrumented API calls
contraindications: Logging free-form debug messages without structure
Non-API operations or internal function calls
workflow_steps: Identify API call context (request type, endpoint, method)
Extract request metadata (model name, parameters, input tokens)
Capture response metadata (status code, output tokens, latency)
Format all attributes according to semantic conventions
Document captured attributes with inline comments
Return structured attribute dictionary
triggers: Wrapping an API call for instrumentation
Need to capture request/response metadata in standardized format
Preparing data for distributed tracing backend
cautions: Do not include raw request/response bodies; extract only metadata
Validate attribute keys against semantic convention schema before output
Handle missing optional attributes gracefully with defaults
output_contract: Structured attribute dictionary conforming to agentops.semconv schema, ready for distributed tracing backend consumption

metadata.prompt: When wrapping an API call, extract request and response metadata and format it as a structured attribute dictionary conforming to semantic conventions. Document what attributes are captured. Use common utilities and semantic convention attributes for consistency.

skill_drafts.name: Async/Sync Method Wrapping
skill_drafts.description: Micro-skill for applying function wrappers to both synchronous and asynchronous API methods, preserving method signatures and return types.
skill_drafts.objective: Instrument both sync and async variants of an API method without breaking existing code
applicable_signals: API provider offers both sync and async versions of the same method
Need to instrument dual-path method variants
Requirement to collect metrics from both execution paths
contraindications: Only sync or only async methods available in the API
Wrapping internal helper functions rather than public API methods
Performance-critical hot paths where wrapper overhead is unacceptable
intervention_moves: Identify sync and async method pairs in the target API
Apply wrapper using wrapt.wrap_function_wrapper or equivalent
Preserve original method signature and return type
Collect instrumentation data within wrapper for both paths
Test wrapped methods to verify behavior preservation
workflow_steps: {'step': 1, 'action': 'Identify the sync and async method pair', 'detail': 'Locate both variants (e.g., method and amethod) in the target API provider'}
{'step': 2, 'action': 'Import wrapper library', 'detail': 'Import wrapt or equivalent function wrapping utility'}
{'step': 3, 'action': 'Define wrapper callback', 'detail': 'Create a callback function that handles instrumentation logic for both sync and async execution'}
{'step': 4, 'action': 'Apply wrapper to sync method', 'detail': 'Use wrap_function_wrapper to instrument the synchronous variant'}
{'step': 5, 'action': 'Apply wrapper to async method', 'detail': 'Use wrap_function_wrapper to instrument the asynchronous variant, preserving coroutine behavior'}
{'step': 6, 'action': 'Test both paths', 'detail': 'Write unit tests for sync and async methods to verify behavior and return type preservation'}
triggers: An API provider offers both sync and async versions of the same method (e.g., openai.ChatCompletion.create vs openai.ChatCompletion.acreate); need to instrument both.
constraints: Wrapper must not alter method signature or return type
Both sync and async paths must be instrumented consistently
Instrumentation data collection must not raise exceptions in either path
cautions: Ensure wrapper handles exceptions gracefully in both sync and async contexts
Test async wrapper with event loop to verify coroutine behavior
Verify return type preservation for both paths before deployment
output_contract: Both sync and async method variants are wrapped and tested; original method behavior and return types are preserved; instrumentation data is collected for both execution paths; no exceptions are raised by the wrapper in either path.

examples.output: Both methods wrapped with instrumentation callback; sync method returns response object; async method returns awaitable response object; metrics collected for both paths
examples.notes: Wrapper preserves original return type and allows downstream code to use methods unchanged
